sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-RLSA key (RB-RLSA) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base Radar Station document archives.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: White Queen building (dome) on Reserve. East end of the building on the 2nd floor.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Weapon mods, Ammunition)
- Three Drawers
- One Intelligence folder
- Loose military tech items
